definitions.cell: one (attribute band, age) pair: n observations, regular = share of n, useful_n = observations whose player's peak is realized, mlb, useful and good = shares of useful_n
definitions.regular: a season with >= 300 MLB PA (hitter) or >= 150 MLB BF (pitcher), MLB = level_id 1 of the dump's per-game files; the outcome is whether the player ever had one through the last dump, the dev_odds definition; every observation counts, so players still young at the last dumps count as not yet regular, the same as dev_odds pot_only
definitions.mlb: share of useful_n whose eventual peak WAA reached -1 (an MLB-level player, a 5th starter or bench bat); user, 2026-09-24: 'if they will ever be anything in the mlb'
definitions.useful: share of useful_n whose eventual peak WAA reached 0 (an average MLB player)
definitions.good: share of useful_n whose eventual peak WAA reached +1.5 (a clear regular)
definitions.peak: eventual peak WAA = max of the player's engine now_WAA over his dumps from the observation's dump on (BLM engine, neutral park, vintages/DEV/.waa_cache); realized, and counted in useful_n, only when some priced dump shows him at age >= 27
definitions.cohort: players first seen at age <= 20 in dumps 2025-2484 who were ever in an org (level R, A, AA, AAA or MLB); dev_odds' cohort
definitions.observation: one player-dump at ages 16-26, in an org at that dump, with every core skill and the Pot grade present (dev_odds obs_all, the rows behind pot_only); the same player counts once per age; the 2025 dump has no Pot grade and is skipped
definitions.age: the dump's Age field: the Jan-1 age, dump_<year> being dated Jan 1 of year+1
definitions.role: P when the dump position is SP, RP or CL, else H
definitions.band: 5-point display band 20..80: the value rounded to the nearest 5, a half rounds up (42.5 -> 45), values below 20 or above 80 clamped
definitions.current: split skills: mean of the vR and vL ratings of that dump, then banded; Ovr and Pot: OOTP's 1-point grade of that dump, banded
definitions.potential: the skill's potential rating of that dump (raw Pot<skill>), banded; no potential basis for Ovr and Pot
definitions.attributes: H: BABIP GAP POW EYE AvK (raw BABIP Gap Pow Eye Ks); P: STU HRR CON PBABIP (raw Stf HRA Ctrl PBABIP); HRR = the app's HRR column = raw HRA, as in dev_odds; raw Mov is not used; Contact (raw Cntct) is left out (user, 2026-09-24: 'please remove contact from the list')
definitions.thin: cells with n < 30 (or useful_n < 30) are thin; they ship with their n so the page can grey them; cells with n = 0 are dropped

notes: Cohort, observations, regular outcome and eventual peak come from dev_odds.py, so these shares agree with the app's Make it % (dev_odds pot_only) and its MLB / useful / good shares.
mlb, useful and good share one denominator (useful_n) and nest: good <= useful <= mlb.
A share is over one attribute alone. Players in the same band differ in every other rating, so read a cell as 'players who looked like this in this one skill'.
useful_n is smaller than n: only players seen at age >= 27 in a priced dump have a realized peak.
